title: Traditional Greek Loukoumades
description: A classic Greek dessert made with deep-fried dough balls, typically drizzled with honey and sprinkled with cinnamon.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and sugar.
Gradually add milk and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes and let it rise for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and divide it into small balls.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Fry the dough balls until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
Drain excess oil and place the loukoumades on a paper towel-lined plate.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with cinnamon.
